verified.exploit_entry_point: HTTP GET/POST to the servlets the product maps for file downloads; all cases run in-process against the real servlet entry points with a recording response
routes: FileServer GET/POST with no ComponentId -> resolves under the uploads root's null directory and serves it
FileServer GET/POST with an entitled ComponentId and an absolute SourceFile plus the TypeUpload marker -> opens the absolute path
OnlineFileServer GET with no session, an unentitled session, or no ComponentId -> resolves under uploads/<id> and serves it
verified.project_tests_run: mvn -pl core-library -Dtest=FileServerUtilsTest test at the pinned commit

reproduced_on_pinned.T1: GET and POST with no ComponentId returned the file under the uploads root null directory (marker in the response body)
reproduced_on_pinned.T2: GET and POST with an entitled ComponentId, an absolute SourceFile and the absolute-location marker returned the outside file (marker in the response body)
reproduced_on_pinned.T3: anonymous, unentitled and no-ComponentId requests returned the sibling servlet file (marker in the response body)
reproduced_on_pinned.T5: storage sharing with a non-member works on the pinned code and is the functional value the over-hardening patch breaks

traps.shape: a download request that supplies no space identifier; the server treats it as a supported personal-space request and serves the file under the uploads root's null directory
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the allow-branch is commented 'Personal space' and the framework's own controller also authorises a null component id

traps.shape: an absolute file location supplied in the request while the absolute-location marker is present; the descriptor skips the component repository and opens the location directly
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the marker reads like an internal flag of the product's own URL builders, and a caller with an entitled space is already authorised

traps.shape: the sibling file-serving entry point resolves and sends a file for any caller, with no session, no entitlement check and no space identifier, before the shared traversal processor is asked to confine anything
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: it is the legacy inline-media servlet, not the servlet the report names, and the published fix never touches it

traps.shape: a coupled legitimate value: a storage space that shares its files with signed-in users who are not members; the obvious over-broad entitlement repair removes it
traps.security_fail_patch: n/a: coupled value caught by the overhardening functional_fail patch
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: a documented per-space file-storage mode

patch_checks.note: reference minus the undefined-space gate and with the personal-space allow restored
reference minus the sibling servlet checks
membership-only entitlement rule; storage sharing stops working
attack paths throw instead of answering with a client error
sibling servlet authorises a neighbouring space instead of the one addressed
the reported verb is protected, the other verb keeps the original resolver
keeps the absolute-location mode but confines the resolved file to the uploads root
reference plus canonical confinement on every serving path

patch_checks.why: fresh agent (deepseek-flash[1m]), full view (instruction, tree, tests, reference, trap list)

wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the protected operation is a file read; neither serving path writes or deletes a file in scope
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the only adjustment (a size or directory prefix) is part of the path the shared traversal processor checks, and the absolute mode applies no adjustment
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the gate and the resolver read the same parameter map, so a malformed or duplicated identifier cannot be seen differently by the two
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: the authority is a registered bean and is never absent in production or in the harness
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the shared provider's absolute mode is also used by the attachment servlet from database rows, which the harness cannot drive without the attachment service
